thread:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: gpu-serving-prod - autoscaler failing to add GPU nodes; queue growth observed. Pager triggered to @oncall.
Sophie L: acked, I'm on it. grabbing logs now.
Raj P: I'm with you Sophie — watching the queue growth metric in grafana (gpu-serving-prod/req-queue). It's spiking across all zones.
Maria G: saw the page, joining. any signs of new nodegroup activity? k8s shows NodeGroup 'gpu-pool-3' stuck Pending for >8m.
Sophie L: yep node objects appear but they're NotReady. kubelet logs show attach errors. tails: ```kubectl -n kube-system logs node-provisioner-xyz | grep -i attach``` shows: "attachVolume: AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:iam::123456:role/eks-node-role is not authorized to perform: ec2:AttachVolume on resource"
Devon K: that smells like iam/passrole or instance profile mismatch. can someone check the launch template and instance profile bound to the ASG?
Raj P: checking AWS console — launch template lt-0a1b2c references InstanceProfile: gpu-instance-role-v2, but cluster nodegroup expects gpu-instance-role-v1. history shows LT was recently patched for image upgrade.
Maria G: mismatch would prevent proper bootstrap scripts — nodes create but kubelet can't register correct RBAC. also seeing taint applied: node.kubernetes.io/uninitialized:NoSchedule on the new nodes.
Sophie L: copying the autoscaler logs for the event window: ```kubectl -n kube-system logs deployment/cluster-autoscaler | sed -n '200,320p'``` -> "Failed to create ASG node: UnauthorizedOperation: You are not authorized to perform: iam:PassRole on resource: role/gpu-node-role-v1"
Devon K: autoscaler is hitting iam:PassRole denied, so it can't attach the proper instance profile -> ASG/launchtemplate creation aborted. that aligns with the NotReady/attach errors.
Sophie L: impact: request queue latency for generate endpoint increased 4x for a handful of customers; degraded throughput on dedicated clusters. I'm marking severity P2 for now — paging escalated earlier.
Maria G: mitigation options: 1) patch IAM to allow autoscaler principal iam:PassRole temporarily 2) manually create nodes with correct instance profile and add them to cluster 3) fallback route: route burst traffic to cpu-fallback pool (lower perf)
Raj P: I'm going to try a hotfix: create a temporary ASG with launch template lt-0a1b2c-fixed that uses gpu-instance-role-v1 and no extra taints. will pre-bake AMI and spin 3 nodes. I'll post commands.
Sophie L: also need a short-term routing change. Maria, can you flip the traffic weight from gpu-serving-prod -> cpu-fallback for non-SLA customers? we have an emergency route in Console.
Maria G: doing that now. patching rollout to send 40% of requests to cpu-fallback. will monitor error budget. :gear:
infra-bot: created ticket INF-4521 to track temporary IAM change and rollback.
Raj P: spun 3 manual nodes with correct instance profile. nodes joined and became Ready after bootstrap (kubelet certs ok). Rebalancing pods now.
Sophie L: confirmed pods scheduling on new nodes, queue length dropping. metrics: queue depth down from 48 -> 8 within 6m. latency recovering.
Devon K: we should still fix autoscaler perms — I'll open a request to IAM to add iam:PassRole for the autoscaler instance principal scoped to role/gpu-node-role-v1 and log the approval flow.
Maria G: rolling back traffic weight to normal in 10m if no regression. current customer-impact note: "short-lived throughput degradation, partial routing fallback applied to reduce tail latency for high-volume customers". I'll update status page.
Sophie L: action items: 1) Devon — IAM change and least-privilege policy, 2) Raj — reconcile launch template versions across nodegroups, 3) Maria — customer incident note + status update, 4) infra — create playbook step to verify LT/InstanceProfile parity before autoscaler rollouts.
Devon K: filed IAM request IAM-9102, asked for expedited approval. linking INF-4521.
infra-bot: reminder: schedule postmortem in #postmortems within 72h.
Sophie L: good job team. I'll keep monitoring until autoscaler resumes successful scale events. leaving handoff to oncall for the next 30m.
Raj P: one more note — we also observed a taint propagation bug where kubelet reports NotReady with taint node.kubernetes.io/uninitialized even after correct profile; file K8S-537 to follow.
Maria G: updated status page and emailed affected account owners with mitigation summary.
Sophie L: closing pager. Will add timeline + logs to INF-4521. follow-up: propose automated preflight check for LT/InstanceProfile on rollout PRs. :thumbsup:
